title: Netgame table and playlists of overlay net.bin in PS3 1.19 order from the player's DATA2 net18.bin, so PC netgame indices equal PS3's (netgame-order/netgame_order.py)
applied: 2026-11-11 (tested on a copy of an import); 1.15.0 Lab hiding + map conversion fix 2026-11-11
notes: Runs after every other net.bin step. The table becomes exactly net18.bin's (what an online / RPCN PS3 1.19 player loads; 271 netgames for net18 2026-11-07): PC entries of the same name are copied whole (PS4 sub-structures and earlier fixes kept) and get the converted PS3 scalar values (PS3 rules; Hardcore stays Hardcore), missing ones are converted like lab_reg.py, PC-only ones (old PS4-retail Hardcore, the 10 lab-custom-* TDM, old Lab Dodgeball, ...) are dropped. Playlists in PS3 order from net18 (PC content-pack word kept). A PS3 map the map list lacks gets an entry: +0x94 = 0 (listed) when its main level is in overlay-r3 pak23_ps4.txt, else 1; PS3 map +0x14 (mode bits, no PS4 slot) is not converted (1.15.0: a net.bin without warzone-multi-comp-pak stopped the step). No Lab maps on PC (1.15.0): every map whose main level starts with lab- gets +0x94 = 1, the 10 netgames on them keep their PS3 index (crossplay) but leave every playlist (TDM, Plunder, Objective, FFA lose one each), and the emptied Lab playlist 0x5242014b keeps its slot with content pack 0xff, which Find Game never lists (helper v7.103 resets a saved pick of it). Same order on every PC (1.15.0): the map list is rebuilt as exactly net18's maps in net18 order (PC-only maps, unreferenced after this step, are dropped: imports rebuilt from the DC recipes had a stale second warzone-multi-comp-pak 0x9fc6005d; it used to keep each PC's history order and append missing maps); netgames and playlists follow net18, whose two accepted versions differ only in Lab slots (map 16, netgames 131, 207..209), all hidden. DCEdit append-only; the net size word of modules.bin is found by module name. Idempotent: exits 0 when ng119.check finds no difference to net18. Logs net18's sha256; log and backups in work/backup-netgame-order. classic.py and apply_maps.py leave a table in this order alone when they run again. Indices 256..270 need the helper's u16 Custom Game index (helper, not this step). reference_check false: manifest.tsv predates the step.
